verdict.rationale: AWS documents its own pieces of autonomous automation. Budgets can automatically apply an IAM policy when a threshold is hit, AgentCore deploys agents to production at scale, and Lambda runs code without managing servers. Scripting through the CLI is also documented. However, nothing in the pack describes scheduling, event triggers, or setting up general background automations end to end, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented scheduled or event-triggered background workflows (e.g. cron or event rules), an explicit setup flow for autonomous background agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
